sanskrit_verse:
प्राजापत्यं चरेत् कृच्छ्रं समावागुरुतल्पगः ।
चान्द्रायणं वा त्रीन् मासानभ्यसेद्वेदसंहिताम् ॥३-२६०
transliteration: prājāpatyaṃ caret kṛcchraṃ samā vā gurutalpagaḥ | cāndrāyaṇaṃ vā trīn māsān abhyased vedasaṃhitām ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has engaged in misconduct with the spouse of the guru must perform the prājāpatya penance or live as a celibate for one year; alternatively, one may undertake the cāndrāyaṇa vow or study the Veda-saṃhitā continuously for three months.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from spiritual lineage and is protected by conscious purity.
Causation arises through violation of sacred relational boundaries.
Capacity-based responsibility requires proportional restoration aligned with spiritual maturity.
Restoration logic emphasizes purification of consciousness over punitive suffering.
Consciousness alignment necessitates disciplined re-engagement with scriptural knowledge.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent violates guru's relational sanctity THEN initiate prājāpatya OR samāvāsa protocol.
IF agent chooses cāndrāyaṇa THEN enforce continuous vedasaṃhitā study for 90 days.
IF agent completes restoration THEN re-integrate into spiritual community without stigma.
IF agent fails completion THEN extend capacity-building phase until readiness confirmed.
supreme_court_application: In cases involving breaches of spiritual authority, the Supreme Court must assess not intent or harm but the restoration of energetic purity and alignment with dharma-vācas. The court shall ensure execution of prescribed śāstric protocols under supervision of recognized ācāryas.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This injunction follows pramāṇa-based causality where misconduct disrupts cosmic order. Responsibility manifests sequentially (anupūrvaśaḥ) via self-imposed discipline. The proportional response restores balance without inflicting pain. Non-punitive reality is upheld as consciousness realigns through intentional practice.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate prājāpatya austerity under qualified oversight.
Establish vedasaṃhitā immersion program with daily progress validation.
Assign mentorship during cāndrāyaṇa observance to monitor integration.
Upon completion, conduct yajña-based reintegration ceremony.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
